window.note: Seven days is the longest available CoinGecko range retaining useful intraday path resolution for this study. Thirty-day sampling is too coarse for reliable intraday trigger ordering.

robustness_cohort.purpose: Remove low-volume microcaps that dominated the original 48h Pump findings and use current Pons V2 DEX-visible names for the Pons robustness subset.

staged_scaling.methodology: Same frozen price-path proxy as the 48h study: local breakout plus strength from recent low; 12h forward path; trigger grid unchanged at 5/10/15/20%.

pump_high_volume.interpretation: The positive Pump result in the earlier 48h study was microcap-driven. In a higher-volume Pump.fun cohort, +10% and +15% scale proxies are consistently negative across every observed asset.

pons_v2.interpretation: The +5% strength proxy is the only tested scale trigger whose asset-level interval remains positive and whose leave-one-asset-out mean stays positive. This supports further Pons-specific shadow testing, not allocation or an add-size decision.

reset_recovery.methodology: Same frozen reset grid as 48h study: drawdown 15/20/25/30/35% and recovery 5/10/15%; 12h forward path. Robustness focuses on higher-volume Pump.fun cohort and Pons V2 cohort.

pump_high_volume.findings: No repeatable positive reset signal. The 15%/5% rule produced one NEET event with -6.3% forward return; 15%/10% and stronger rules produced no qualifying events in the higher-volume Pump cohort.
pump_high_volume.interpretation: Earlier Pump reset evidence was driven by STONKS PARK. Removing microcap dominance removes the apparent Pump reset edge.

rationale: 15/10 balances sample size and confirmation strength.
All four Pons V2 assets with qualifying events have positive asset-level mean outcomes.
Dropping any single asset leaves the equal-asset mean positive (7.28% to 12.21%).
The signal appears on all seven days, although daily average returns are negative on three days; therefore it is not an unconditional entry rule.
Structural/execution filters remain necessary before allocation.

conclusions.staged_scaling_pump: Do not promote or parameterize simple price-strength staged scaling. Keep the generic machinery concept only; future Pump scaling would need additional non-price confirmation and new evidence.
conclusions.staged_scaling_pons: Market-path evidence supports a provisional +5% strength/local-breakout shadow trigger. Add size and total-position ceiling remain unset; no allocation authority.
conclusions.reset_recovery_pump: Do not freeze Pump thresholds. Keep research open but deprioritized.
conclusions.reset_recovery_pons: Market-path evidence is strong enough to freeze a provisional shadow shape: >=15% flush followed by >=10% recovery. This is not sufficient for PAPER allocation without breadth, concentration, creator/distribution, liquidity/depth and executable-cost confirmation.
conclusions.conclusive_scope: Conclusive for research triage and provisional shadow parameterization; not conclusive for profitability certification or allocation authority.

pons_scaling: Use +5% strength/local-breakout as the frozen shadow trigger in the finished PAPER observer.
Do not set scale add percentage or maximum total exposure until position-context and executable after-cost evidence exist.
pons_reset: Use 15% drawdown / 10% recovery as the frozen market-path shadow shape.
Require the already-staged structural evidence categories before any shadow-qualified decision is considered complete.
pump: No active staged scaling or reset-recovery parameter should be composed into the first PAPER smoke from this research.

limitations: Approx. 85-minute sampling cannot prove intrabar ordering or actual executable fill quality.
No buyer-cluster, concentration, creator/distribution, exact depth or quote/slippage path.
Confidence intervals are descriptive equal-asset normal approximations, not formal strategy profitability inference.
Pons V2 sample contains only assets with enough public chart history; Commander Vrax lacked sufficient comparable history.
